id: title:MattBro:require the mapped user s verified email for vercel sso

review.posthog_relevance: Adds fallback and precise claim-based email verification checks for Vercel SSO identity, supporting account association and preventing account duplication in SSO flows.
review.reason: The implementation chunk P1.F3 and P1.F4 adds a fallback parameter and a helper method to check Vercel SSO claims against stored user email, while P1.F3.H3 adds a corresponding test. This represents a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement for the Vercel SSO connector, allowing the system to handle missing or mismatched claim names and verify account linkage.
review.uncertainty: The chunk also includes a test-only chunk P1.F5, which does not contribute to the score. The tier is assigned based on the implementation changes, not the test assertions. No unverified outcomes or adoption are inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single group. No tier assigned. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a fallback parameter to the email_verified claim, allowing the payload to use the 'email_verified' key if 'user_email_verified' is absent.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows SSO claims to carry an email-verified status even when the upstream Vercel response uses a different claim name, supporting the downstream email-verification-dependent SSO flow.

observations.behavior: Adds a new helper method and its use to check if a Vercel claim both asserts email verification and matches the user's stored email, rather than relying solely on the user's stored is_email_verified flag.
observations.code_quote: return claims.user_email_verified is True and (claims.user_email or "").lower() == email.lower()
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a precise, claim-based check for email ownership and verification, which is used downstream to decide whether an SSO token can complete a login without requiring a separate PostHog account, and to avoid account duplication.

observations.behavior: Adds a new SSO test, including a user mapping and an SSO flow, and checks that the redirect does not include an email parameter.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a test for the SSO redirect behavior when a user mapping exists and the account is already associated, checking that the redirect does not include an email parameter.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains only test code. No implementation changes are supplied, so no score can be assigned.
